name: The Missing Diplomat
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Whoa, this looks way too complex to be something to just lead you astray. I shouldn't even be looking at this stuff. Take it to Trias--he'll be able to make sense of it. And DON'T let anyone get in your way. This is bigger than me. It might even be bigger than him, but we'll see.

And do me a favor, adventurer, don't tell anyone I helped you. If my superiors found out I knew about any of this and didn't share it with them they'd probably hang me.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Defias Docket to Elling Trias in Stormwind.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Yeah... this is an interesting read. Jorgen and DeLavey were smart to bring me in on this.

Seems the Defias have been trying pretty hard to complete this plan of theirs. Hmm... what's this? Fist? That's a familiar name.
narrative.requestItemsText: I see you're back, and in one piece. We both know you're not here for cheese, so let's cut out the pleasantries. Was Backus any help, or have you even left for Duskwood yet?
